```{r setup}
# phenotypic data
pheno <- read.csv(
  "~/ABIDE_Project/abide_data/ABIDE_pcp/Phenotypic_V1_0b_preprocessed1.csv"
)
pheno <- pheno[, c("SUB_ID", "DX_GROUP", "SITE_ID")]
pheno$DX_GROUP <- ifelse(pheno$DX_GROUP == 1, 1, 0) # asd = 1, control = 0
pheno$SUB_ID <- as.numeric(pheno$SUB_ID)


# load fixed model splits
splits <- read.csv(
  "~/ABIDE_Project/graphs/model_splits.csv"
)
splits$SUB_ID <- as.numeric(splits$SUB_ID)


# load all fc files
files <- list.files(
  "~/ABIDE_Project/abide_data/ABIDE_pcp/cpac/nofilt_noglobal",
  pattern = "rois_cc200.1D",

)

```


```{r build dataset}
feature_list <- list()
labels <- c()
site_ids <- c()
subject_ids <- c()
corr_matrices <- list()
template_matrix <- cor(read.table(files[1], header = FALSE))
region_pairs <- which(upper.tri(template_matrix), arr.ind = TRUE)
feature_names <- paste0("R", region_pairs[,1], "_R", region_pairs[,2])

for (f in files) {
  sub_id <- sub(".*_(\\d+)_rois_cc200.1D", "\\1", basename(f))
  sub_id <- as.numeric(sub_id)

  label <- pheno$DX_GROUP[pheno$SUB_ID == sub_id]
  site <- pheno$SITE_ID[pheno$SUB_ID == sub_id]

  if (length(label) == 0) next # skip if no match

  ts <- read.table(f, header = FALSE)
  ts <- as.matrix(sapply(ts, as.numeric))

  # correlation matrix
  corr_matrix <- cor(ts)
  corr_matrix[is.na(corr_matrix)] <- 0
  corr_matrices[[length(corr_matrices) + 1]] <- corr_matrix

  features <- corr_matrix[upper.tri(corr_matrix)] # get upper triangle indicies (brain region pairs)

  feature_list[[length(feature_list) + 1]] <- features
  labels <- c(labels, label)
  subject_ids <- c(subject_ids, sub_id)
  site_ids <- c(site_ids, site)
}

# corr matrices
asd_mats <- corr_matrices[labels == 1]
ctrl_mats <- corr_matrices[labels == 0]
mean_asd <- Reduce("+", asd_mats) / length(asd_mats)
mean_ctrl <- Reduce("+", ctrl_mats) / length(ctrl_mats)

diff_matrix <- mean_asd - mean_ctrl

# convert to dataframe
X <- matrix(unlist(feature_list),
            nrow = length(feature_list),
            byrow = TRUE)
template_matrix <- corr_matrices[[1]]
region_pairs <- which(upper.tri(template_matrix), arr.ind = TRUE)

colnames(X) <- paste0("R", region_pairs[,1], "_R", region_pairs[,2])

df <- as.data.frame(X)
df$DX_GROUP <- labels
df$SUB_ID <- subject_ids
df$SITE_ID <- site_ids


# fixed model split
df <- merge(
  df,
  splits,
  by = "SUB_ID",
  all.x = TRUE
)

table(df$split, useNA = "ifany")
table(df$split, df$DX_GROUP)


# verify expected fixed split

stopifnot(
  sum(df$split == "train") == 559,
  sum(df$split == "validation") == 140,
  sum(df$split == "test") == 172
)
stopifnot(
  sum(df$split == "test" & df$DX_GROUP == 0) == 98,
  sum(df$split == "test" & df$DX_GROUP == 1) == 74
)

image(mean_asd)
image(mean_ctrl)
image(diff_matrix)
heatmap(diff_matrix)

nrow(df)
table(df$DX_GROUP)
dim(df)
```

```{r baseline_models}
set.seed(123)

cat("Starting baseline\n")


# macro-f1 function
macro_f1 <- function(actual, predicted) {
  conf <- table(
    factor(actual, levels = c(0,1)),
    factor(predicted, levels = c(0,1))
  )
  
  # f1 for control class
  tp_0 <- conf["0", "0"]
  fp_0 <- sum(conf[, "0"]) - tp_0
  fn_0 <- sum(conf["0", ]) - tp_0
  
  precision_0 <- ifelse(
    tp_0 + fp_0 == 0,
    0,
    tp_0 / (tp_0 + fp_0)
  )
  recall_0 <- ifelse(
    tp_0 + fn_0 == 0,
    0,
    tp_0 / (tp_0 + fn_0)
  )
  f1_0 <- ifelse(
    precision_0 + recall_0 == 0,
    0,
    2 * precision_0 * recall_0 /
      (precision_0 + recall_0)
  )
  
  # f1 for asd class
  tp_1 <- conf["1", "1"]
  fp_1 <- sum(conf[, "1"]) - tp_1
  fn_1 <- sum(conf["1", ]) - tp_1
  
  precision_1 <- ifelse(
    tp_1 + fp_1 == 0,
    0,
    tp_1 / (tp_1 + fp_1)
  )
  recall_1 <- ifelse(
    tp_1 + fn_1 == 0,
    0,
    tp_1 / (tp_1 + fn_1)
  )
  f1_1 <- ifelse(
    precision_1 + recall_1 == 0,
    0,
    2 * precision_1 * recall_1 /
      (precision_1 + recall_1)
  )
  
  mean(c(f1_0, f1_1)) # macro-f1
}


# metrics function
calculate_metrics <- function(actual, probabilities, predicted) {
  accuracy <- mean(predicted == actual)
  f1 <- macro_f1(actual, predicted)
  conf <- table(
    factor(actual, levels = c(0,1)),
    factor(predicted, levels = c(0,1))
  )
  conf <- as.matrix(conf)
  
  roc_obj <- tryCatch(
    roc(
      actual,
      probabilities,
      levels = c(0,1),
      direction = "<",
      quiet = TRUE
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  if (is.null(roc_obj)) {
    auc_value <- NA
  } else {
    auc_value <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
  }
  return(
    list(
      accuracy = accuracy,
      f1 = f1,
      auc = auc_value,
      confusion_matrix = conf
    )
  )
}

# fixed data splits
train <- df[df$split == "train", ]
validation <- df[df$split == "validation", ]
test <- df[df$split == "test", ]


# check split sizes
cat("Training subjects:", nrow(train), "\n")
cat("Validation subjects:", nrow(validation), "\n")
cat("Test subjects:", nrow(test), "\n\n")


# split features and labels
feature_columns <- !(names(df) %in%
                       c("DX_GROUP", "SUB_ID", "SITE_ID", "split"))
train_x <- train[, feature_columns]
validation_x <- validation[, feature_columns]
test_x <- test[, feature_columns]
train_y <- train$DX_GROUP
validation_y <- validation$DX_GROUP
test_y <- test$DX_GROUP


# scale data
train_x_scaled <- scale(train_x)
train_center <- attr(train_x_scaled, "scaled:center")
train_scale <- attr(train_x_scaled, "scaled:scale")

validation_x_scaled <- scale(
  validation_x,
  center = train_center,
  scale = train_scale)
test_x_scaled <- scale(
  test_x,
  center = train_center,
  scale = train_scale)

nzv <- nearZeroVar(train_x_scaled) # remove near-zero variance

if(length(nzv) > 0){
  train_x_scaled <- train_x_scaled[, -nzv, drop = FALSE]
  validation_x_scaled <-
    validation_x_scaled[, -nzv, drop = FALSE]
  test_x_scaled <-
    test_x_scaled[, -nzv, drop = FALSE]
}


# pca
pca <- prcomp(
  train_x_scaled,
  center = FALSE,
  scale. = FALSE
)

train_pca <- pca$x[, 1:20, drop = FALSE] # keeping first 20 principal components

validation_pca <- predict(
  pca,
  newdata = validation_x_scaled
)[, 1:20, drop = FALSE]

test_pca <- predict(
  pca,
  newdata = test_x_scaled
)[, 1:20, drop = FALSE]


# create model data
train_data <- data.frame(train_pca)
train_data$DX_GROUP <- train_y

validation_data <- data.frame(validation_pca)
test_data <- data.frame(test_pca)

```

```{r repeated runs}
seeds <- c(123, 456, 789)
run_results <- list()
site_predictions <- list()

# logistic regression
for (run_seed in seeds) {
  cat("Logistic regression with Seed: ", run_seed, "\n")
  lr_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  lr_model <- glm(
    DX_GROUP ~ .,
    data = train_data,
    family = "binomial"
  )
  lr_time <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - lr_start

  lr_validation_probs <- predict(
    lr_model,
    newdata = validation_data,
    type = "response"
  )

  lr_validation_preds <- ifelse(
    lr_validation_probs > 0.5,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  site_predictions[[length(site_predictions) + 1]] <-
    data.frame(
      Model = "Logistic Regression",
      Seed = run_seed,
      SITE_ID = validation$SITE_ID,
      Actual = validation_y,
      Probability = lr_validation_probs,
      Predicted = lr_validation_preds
    )

  lr_validation_metrics <- calculate_metrics(
    validation_y,
    lr_validation_probs,
    lr_validation_preds
  )
  
  # test predictions
  lr_inference_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]

  lr_test_probs <- predict(
    lr_model,
    newdata = test_data,
    type = "response"
  )
  lr_test_preds <- ifelse(
    lr_test_probs > 0.5,
    1,
    0
  )

  lr_inference_time <-
    proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - lr_inference_start

  lr_test_metrics <- calculate_metrics(
    test_y,
    lr_test_probs,
    lr_test_preds
  )

  #print results
  cat("\nTraining time:", lr_time, "seconds\n")

  cat("\nValidation:\n")
  cat("Accuracy:", lr_validation_metrics$accuracy, "\n")
  cat("Macro-F1:", lr_validation_metrics$f1, "\n")
  cat("ROC-AUC:", lr_validation_metrics$auc, "\n")

  cat("\nNYU test:\n")
  cat("Accuracy:", lr_test_metrics$accuracy, "\n")
  cat("Macro-F1:", lr_test_metrics$f1, "\n")
  cat("ROC-AUC:", lr_test_metrics$auc, "\n")
  cat("Inference time:", lr_inference_time, "seconds\n")

  cat("\nNYU confusion matrix:\n")
  print(lr_test_metrics$confusion_matrix)

  # save run
  run_results[[length(run_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    Model = "Logistic Regression",
    Seed = run_seed,

    Validation_Accuracy = lr_validation_metrics$accuracy,
    Validation_Macro_F1 = lr_validation_metrics$f1,
    Validation_ROC_AUC = lr_validation_metrics$auc,

    Test_Accuracy = lr_test_metrics$accuracy,
    Test_Macro_F1 = lr_test_metrics$f1,
    Test_ROC_AUC = lr_test_metrics$auc,

    Training_Time = lr_time,
    Inference_Time = lr_inference_time
  )
}


# multilayer perceptron
for (run_seed in seeds) {
  cat("MLP with seed: ", run_seed, "\n")
  set.seed(run_seed)
  
  # train mlp
  mlp_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
  mlp_model <- nnet(
    DX_GROUP ~ .,
    data = train_data,
    size = 5,
    maxit = 200,
    decay = 0.01,
    trace = FALSE
  )
  mlp_time <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - mlp_start
  
  mlp_validation_probs <- predict(
    mlp_model,
    newdata = validation_data,
    type = "raw"
  )

  mlp_validation_probs <- as.vector(
    mlp_validation_probs
  )

  mlp_validation_preds <- ifelse(
    mlp_validation_probs > 0.5,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  site_predictions[[length(site_predictions) + 1]] <-
    data.frame(
      Model = "MLP",
      Seed = run_seed,
      SITE_ID = validation$SITE_ID,
      Actual = validation_y,
      Probability = mlp_validation_probs,
      Predicted = mlp_validation_preds
    )
  
  mlp_validation_metrics <- calculate_metrics(
    validation_y,
    mlp_validation_probs,
    mlp_validation_preds
  )
  
  
  # test predictions
  mlp_inference_start <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]

  mlp_test_probs <- predict(
    mlp_model,
    newdata = test_data,
    type = "raw"
  )

  mlp_test_probs <- as.vector(
    mlp_test_probs
  )

  mlp_test_preds <- ifelse(
    mlp_test_probs > 0.5,
    1,
    0
  )

  mlp_inference_time <-
    proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - mlp_inference_start

  mlp_test_metrics <- calculate_metrics(
    test_y,
    mlp_test_probs,
    mlp_test_preds
  )
  
  # print results
  cat("\nTraining time:", mlp_time, "seconds\n")

  cat("\nValidation:\n")
  cat("Accuracy:", mlp_validation_metrics$accuracy, "\n")
  cat("Macro-F1:", mlp_validation_metrics$f1, "\n")
  cat("ROC-AUC:", mlp_validation_metrics$auc, "\n")

  cat("\nNYU test:\n")
  cat("Accuracy:", mlp_test_metrics$accuracy, "\n")
  cat("Macro-F1:", mlp_test_metrics$f1, "\n")
  cat("ROC-AUC:", mlp_test_metrics$auc, "\n")
  cat("Inference time:", mlp_inference_time, "seconds\n")

  cat("\nNYU confusion matrix:\n")
  print(mlp_test_metrics$confusion_matrix)
  
  # save run
  run_results[[length(run_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
    Model = "MLP",
    Seed = run_seed,

    Validation_Accuracy = mlp_validation_metrics$accuracy,
    Validation_Macro_F1 = mlp_validation_metrics$f1,
    Validation_ROC_AUC = mlp_validation_metrics$auc,

    Test_Accuracy = mlp_test_metrics$accuracy,
    Test_Macro_F1 = mlp_test_metrics$f1,
    Test_ROC_AUC = mlp_test_metrics$auc,

    Training_Time = mlp_time,
    Inference_Time = mlp_inference_time
  )
}


# per-site validation performance
site_predictions_df <- do.call(rbind, site_predictions)
site_run_results <- list()

site_groups <- split(
  site_predictions_df,
  list(
    site_predictions_df$Model,
    site_predictions_df$Seed,
    site_predictions_df$SITE_ID
  ),
  drop = TRUE
)

for (group in site_groups) {
  site_metrics <- calculate_metrics(
    actual = group$Actual,
    probabilities = group$Probability,
    predicted = group$Predicted
  )
  
  control_count <- sum(group$Actual == 0)
  asd_count <- sum(group$Actual == 1)

  site_run_results[[length(site_run_results) + 1]] <-
    data.frame(
      Model = group$Model[1],
      Seed = group$Seed[1],
      SITE_ID = group$SITE_ID[1],
      N = nrow(group),
      Controls = control_count,
      ASD = asd_count,
      Accuracy = site_metrics$accuracy,
      Macro_F1 = site_metrics$f1,
      ROC_AUC = site_metrics$auc
    )
}

site_run_results <- do.call(rbind, site_run_results)


cat("Per-site Validation Results from each run\n")
print(
  site_run_results[
    order(site_run_results$Model,
          site_run_results$SITE_ID,
          site_run_results$Seed),
  ],
  row.names = FALSE
)


# per-site mean and sd across runs
site_summary_groups <- split(
  site_run_results,
  interaction(
    site_run_results$Model,
    site_run_results$SITE_ID,
    drop = TRUE
  )
)

site_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(site_summary_groups, function(group) {

    data.frame(
      Model = group$Model[1],
      SITE_ID = group$SITE_ID[1],
      N = group$N[1],
      Controls = group$Controls[1],
      ASD = group$ASD[1],

      Mean_Accuracy = mean(group$Accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD_Accuracy = sd(group$Accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),

      Mean_Macro_F1 = mean(group$Macro_F1, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD_Macro_F1 = sd(group$Macro_F1, na.rm = TRUE),

      Mean_ROC_AUC = mean(group$ROC_AUC, na.rm = TRUE),
      SD_ROC_AUC = sd(group$ROC_AUC, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
)


cat("per-site Validation results - mean +/- sd\n")
print(
  site_summary[
    order(site_summary$SITE_ID, site_summary$Model),
  ],
  row.names = FALSE
)

# save results 
write.csv(
  site_run_results,
  "per_site_validation_each_run.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  site_summary,
  "per_site_validation_summary.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# combining all results
all_results <- do.call(rbind, run_results)

cat("Individual run results\n")
print(all_results, row.names = FALSE)

metrics <- c(
  "Validation_Accuracy",
  "Validation_Macro_F1",
  "Validation_ROC_AUC",
  "Test_Accuracy",
  "Test_Macro_F1",
  "Test_ROC_AUC",
  "Training_Time",
  "Inference_Time"
)

summary_results <- data.frame()
for (model_name in unique(all_results$Model)) {
  model_runs <- all_results[
    all_results$Model == model_name,
  ]
  for (metric in metrics) {
    values <- model_runs[[metric]]
    summary_results <- rbind(
      summary_results,
      data.frame(
        Model = model_name,
        Metric = metric,
        Mean = mean(values, na.rm = TRUE),
        SD = sd(values, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    )
  }
}

cat("Mean and sd across 3 runs\n")
print(summary_results, row.names = FALSE)


# performance table
performance_summary <- summary_results[
  summary_results$Metric %in% c(
    "Test_Accuracy",
    "Test_Macro_F1",
    "Test_ROC_AUC"
  ),
]

performance_summary$Mean_SD <- sprintf(
  "%.4f +/- %.4f",
  performance_summary$Mean,
  performance_summary$SD
)

cat("NYU Test performance - mean +/- sd\n")
print(
  performance_summary[
    , c("Model", "Metric", "Mean_SD")
  ],
  row.names = FALSE
)
```
